source.pubchem_synonym_feature: pc_lsynonyms.npy; row-aligned log(1 + PubChem synonym count)
source.score_type: public labelled development-panel replay, not official leaderboard score

method.baseline: cached A+B plus 0.5 fold0 full/partial FPNet scores; v10 prior; 5,000 partial-score shortlist union top 200 prior; 0.15 prior coefficient; metric-identity dedupe; exclude pool identities except truth
method.candidate: same replay with fixed +0.5 * log1p(PubChem synonym count) added to the prior before the 5,000/200 shortlist and final ranking
method.canary_selection: first 64 IDs in lexical SHA256 order over 'casmi-v14-synonym-prior-fixed-canary-v1|'; label-free and fixed before scoring
method.canary_gate: full panel allowed only if candidate MRR does not fall and top-1 does not fall on the fixed 64-query canary

limitations: Public development panel is a labelled training-derived natural-product subset and does not establish hidden-test performance.
The synonym feature and fixed weight were already reported from this panel by the public baseline author; this replay verifies transfer/alignment and does not provide an untouched scientific holdout.
Cached scores are used; no spectra, model weights, fitting, or GPU inference are used.
